mentions.name: Plimsoll Line
mentions.description: An iOS app built on top of the Apple Reminders app that assigns each todo item an impact multiplier between -1.0 and +1.0, giving tasks emotional weights. The net weight of the items indicates overall mood or emotional burden and is visualized as a water line that rises as the net weight becomes more negative, with planned features to nudge the user into addressing a rising water line. It has no signup, subscription, or PII collection, and is monetized only via a tip jar through App Store IAP.
mentions.problem: Ships have a max-load line (the Plimsoll Line) to prevent overloading, but the author's todo list had no equivalent way to surface emotional load; the app exists to make emotional burden visible and put mental health above raw productivity.
mentions.audience: Personal use: the author built it to lower their own stress and anxiety, with the emotional weight of each item surfacing their overall mood.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://plimsoll-line.app

I learned that ships have a "max load" line (or Plimsoll Line) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Load_line_(watercraft) to prevent overloading them with cargos, but my todo list didn't. So I built an app to surface my emotional load and put mental health above raw productivity.
